name: Journey to Astranaar
summary: Fiora Longears sends Alliance travelers from Theramore north to Astranaar. There, they report to Shindrell Swiftfire in Ashenvale, where the night elves face war and unrest.

sections.title: From the Coast into the Woods
sections.body: Alliance travelers arrive in Dustwallow Marsh aboard the ferry from Menethil Harbor, often seeking purpose in northern Kalimdor. At Theramore, Fiora Longears directs capable hands inland toward Astranaar, Ashenvale's main night elven settlement. The route winds beneath ancient, shadowed canopies and leads into a forest strained by war and unrest.

sections.title: An Unspoken Recommendation
sections.body: Fiora tells travelers not to mention her name in Astranaar because Shindrell Swiftfire does not know her. Fiora's role is to direct fresh Alliance talent where it is needed. Shindrell welcomes able-bodied defenders when they arrive. Ashenvale remains breathtaking, but it is no longer the peaceful sanctuary it once was.

faq.q: Where does the Journey to Astranaar quest begin?
aliases: where to pick up journey to astranaar
faq.answer: The journey begins with Fiora Longears in Theramore, on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh. She offers it to Alliance travelers from the Eastern Kingdoms who seek to help in Kalimdor.

faq.q: Who do I need to talk to in Astranaar?
aliases: where to turn in journey to astranaar
faq.answer: Speak with Shindrell Swiftfire, a night elf in Astranaar, the central Alliance town in Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why does Fiora say not to mention her name?
faq.answer: Fiora says not to mention her name because Shindrell does not know her personally. She directs eager newcomers to an outpost in need of assistance.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: It leads Alliance travelers from Dustwallow Marsh into Ashenvale and introduces them to Astranaar, their main base in the forest.

faq.q: What kind of trouble is happening in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Ashenvale is no longer tranquil. Horde incursions, demonic corruption lingering from the Third War, and local wildlife stirred by recent conflicts trouble the forest.

faq.q: What quest leads into Journey to Astranaar?
faq.answer: The journey follows a short introduction called Fiora Longears, which directs travelers arriving in Dustwallow Marsh to speak with her in Theramore.

angles.text: As an Alliance recruit, you travel from the relatively safe ports of Dustwallow Marsh into Ashenvale's contested wilderness.
As a night elf, you return to your heartland under siege and defend Ashenvale's sacred boughs alongside foreign allies.
As a human arriving from Menethil Harbor, you take your first steps into Kalimdor's interior and honor the Alliance pledge to aid the night elves.
